name: Storiza corpus of early reader story recordings
summary: A planned corpus of about 80 hours of K-3 children reading stories aloud, across U.S. dialects, with word-aligned reading-error labels and baseline speech recognition models.

license.note: No license is named on the project page. Its audio is to be restricted, governed through the Linguistic Data Consortium under IRB data-banking approvals.

access_note: Planned: restricted audio through the Linguistic Data Consortium, models on Hugging Face, scripts on GitHub and OSF.
cite: The Storiza Corpus of Early Reader Story Recordings: A Dialect-Inclusive Speech Dataset for Reading Technology Development. K-12 AI Infrastructure Program project.
expected: The project page gives no date; the Program expects its new public goods to be released in summer 2027.
